name: Kamo (Shizuoka, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kamo village emblem in red: a stylised swirl of a curved stroke with a disc.
history: Flag of the former village of Kamo in Shizuoka Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in January 1973.

features.role: Kamo village emblem — a stylised swirl of a curved stroke with a disc
